selectedAssets.alt: Four fictional adult women in short copper-blue, lilac, ruby-ivory, and emerald RAZE looks stand linked at Dublin's Grand Canal Dock while the woman at left kisses the blonde woman and a stylized smoke cloud rises far behind the glass skyline.
Four fictional adult women in short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and blue-green RAZE outfits wear pumps and bright rainbow knee-highs on Galway's Long Walk as the two women at right share a kiss.

Four fictional adult women in short copper-silver, pink, turquoise-ivory, and plum RAZE looks wear pumps and colorful thigh-high hosiery on a Killarney lake terrace while the blonde woman kisses her neighbor's cheek.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze, blue-copper, black-magenta, and teal RAZE looks wear dramatic metallic knee-high boots on the Cliffs of Moher viewing platform as the two women at right lean together affectionately.
